description: Which window RP2-v3 results may be published under. `adopted` records the window the repository has already frozen, not a preference chosen here; changing it is a recorded configuration change and requires a reason in docs/rp2_v3/STUDY_WINDOW.md.

twelve_month.note: The end is exclusive, so the last trading session inside this window is the last one before 2026-07-21. Adopting it discards roughly 309 of the 389 development sessions every existing artifact was built on, and every frozen RP2 result would be superseded rather than corrected. `last_session` is the final trading session inside the window and is not known until Block 1 has been re-run against it; publication refuses until it is recorded, so the window cannot be shortened by a run that simply stopped early.
twelve_month.last_session_is: The final session eligible for D or V inside the frozen window, which is not the calendar day before the exclusive end. 2026-07-20 is a market session but Block 1 assigns it to the sealed Phase 8 cohort, and the run manifest refuses BURNED inputs, so a rebuild reaching it would either be impossible or would read a sealed cohort.
twelve_month.end_exclusive_note: 2026-07-21, from the rule. The window is [first_session, end_exclusive); last_session is the last day inside it that a rebuild may actually use.

partition.note: The window every RP2 and RP2-v3 artifact was actually built on: D 2024-08-02 to 2026-03-23 (389 sessions), V 2026-03-24 to 2026-07-17 (80), so the exclusive end is the day after the last session. Adopting this amends a rule AGENTS.md calls binding, which the rule itself says requires a recorded configuration change.

adopted_because: Recorded configuration change of 2026-08-21, methodology decision 84, made by the owner of the research programme: the partition is the RP2 study window. AGENTS.md's twelve-month freeze requires another recorded configuration change to widen or shorten, and this is it; the twelve-month rule is retained for the acquisition programme it was written for.
consequence: Nothing is rebuilt and no number changes. D keeps 389 development sessions and V its 80, which is the sample every existing RP2 and RP2-v3 artifact was built on. Measured before deciding: only 170 of the 389 development sessions fall inside the twelve-month window, so adopting that instead would have discarded 219 of them and required Block 1 to be re-run with a lower bound it does not have.
